preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 5, inclusive.
The length of the string S is between 1 and 1000 for the first two subtasks, inclusive.
The length of the string S is between 1 and 10^5 for the third subtask, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == number of positions to insert a character to make S[i] a palindrome
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output should be the number of positions where a character can be inserted to make the string a palindrome.
